reason: Remove is only in the bar's block group, which shows while a card is selected, and the bar is before the text: Shift+Tab to it passes through the text, which clears the selection. Batch 4 of 0.19.3 (card selected by keyboard, Delete removes it).

The text bar's tools unmount when the text loses focus (src/MarkdownEditor.tsx setInText), so Tab can never reach them and Alt+F10 does nothing. Batch 4 of 0.19.3 adds Alt+F10 and the toolbar pattern.
